title: Summer 2026 Ceramic Internship
commitment: 13 weeks (May 26 – Aug 22, 2026); 40 hours/week; includes 1-week paid workshop and 1-week break
cost_text: Tuition coverage for one workshop, $3,000 scholarship, housing, meals during workshops, clay, and all firing access
evidence_quote: Interns will gain experience running electric, gas-reduction, raku, and wood kilns. Depending on interest and time, interns will get to experience firing their own work multiple times in any of the mentioned firing methods. Interns will participate in the Salt Fire (our catenary chamber of the Anagama Kiln).
evidence_sentence: The internship page states interns gain hands-on experience with wood, gas-reduction, raku, and salt firing in the Anagama kiln.
how_to_join: Applications open Jan 1 - Feb 15, 2026; interns announced March 1, 2026. Applications closed as of today.
pay_text: Tuition coverage for one workshop, $3,000 scholarship completion bonus, housing, workshop meals, studio access, clay, glazes, and firing opportunities included
source_quote:
Applications are closed. Interns will be announced on March 1st.
We are offering two summer internship positions for 2026. Interns will receive hands-on experience in running a professional art studio and education center.
summary: A 13-week summer residency (May 26 – Aug 22) for two interns to gain hands-on experience with all kiln types: wood, gas-reduction, raku, and salt firing in the Anagama. Includes housing, meals, tuition for one workshop, $3,000 scholarship, and studio access. Applications are now closed for 2026.
